entities.summary: The Neradje Mosque or Neradjes, formerly known as the Gazi Hüseyin Pasha Mosque, is a former mosque located in the old town of Rethymno, on the island of Crete, Greece. Completed during the Ottoman era, the former mosque was abandoned in 1924, and the structure was repurposed as a music school.
